title: itembank audit report
description: The strict machine-readable report contract of the closed authoring loop and curriculum auditor (Phase 11, D-02/D-04/D-13/D-17). One report carries the outcome of a bounded authoring run (status proposed/written/failed/already_completed with proposal, diff, findings, manifest, and volume records) or of a coverage audit (cited coverage rows with explicit covered/partial/conflicting/gap/unknown/stale states and input fingerprints). Every report is reproducible from request, source fingerprints, bank fingerprint, adapter profile, and tool version (D-17).

schema_version.description: This document's own schema version; must equal x-itembank-version.

status.description: The run outcome. coverage marks a citation-first curriculum audit report (plan 11-03).

request_fingerprint.description: The deterministic fingerprint of the bounded request that produced this report (D-17); empty on coverage audits, which have no request.

run_id.description: The deterministic run identity: request + bank-before + source + profile + tool version (AUTH-01).

mode.description: The permission mode of an authoring run (D-12); absent on coverage audits.

write_allowed.description: Whether the permission decision allowed a writer call (D-12/D-14).

attempts.description: The number of author attempts made before the outcome (D-05).

outcome.description: The failure classification on a failed run (D-08).

findings.description: Versioned structured retry findings by kind (scope/lint/quality), in attempt order (D-06).

retained_draft.description: The complete final author response retained on exhaustion (D-08); the report never claims a partial prefix.

proposal.description: The immutable preflighted proposal (D-17); present on proposed/written outcomes.

manifest.description: The write manifest of a completed writer call (D-15); present on written/already_completed outcomes.

coverage.description: Cited objective rows of a coverage audit (plan 11-03), sorted by source locator and objective key.

stale.description: True when either input fingerprint no longer matches the cited source/bank; a stale report is never treated as current (D-04).

bank_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the exact bank evaluated.

source_fingerprints.description: The fingerprints of every source involved, sorted and deduplicated.

tool_version.description: The tool version that produced this report, so a later run can recompute staleness (D-17).

proposed_volume.description: Units proposed before generation in full autonomy (AUDIT-09).

rejected_volume.description: Units rejected by scope/lint/quality or permission.

per_objective_volume.description: Objective -> {proposed, completed, rejected, retried, written} volume breakdown (D-13).

kind.description: The gate family that produced these records (D-06).

records.description: One record per finding; lint records carry code/field/item/message, quality records the full finding shape.

record.description: The union record shape of the structured retry findings (scope/lint/quality).

unit.description: One declared reversible unit (D-16): the smallest accepted item/additive edit.

profile.description: The adapter profile that generated the draft; empty when injected.

units.description: The declared reversible units of this proposal (D-16).

diff.description: The reproducible unified diff of bank-before -> bank-after (D-17).

bank_after_text.description: The complete proposed bank text; the only thing a writer may write.

lint_errors.description: model.lint error records (empty means the full candidate lints clean).

before_image.description: The content-addressed before-image path; empty-before artifacts record before_exists separately.

before_exists.description: False for a newly created derived report artifact with no before-image (11-05).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the prepared state.

git_commit.description: The machine-authored commit hash when the Git backend applied the write (D-15).

state.description: The citation-first coverage state; uncovered evidence is never covered (D-02).

source_citations.description: Exact current source-span citations; empty citations keep the state at unknown.

bank_item_ids.description: Exact stable bank item ids cited as covering; empty keeps the state at unknown/gap.

candidate_materials.description: Inert material pointers only; they never authorize generation (AUDIT-04/D-18).
